chapter: Bennie Moten, Basie and the Reno
title: Moten lets six players go and rebuilds
summary: After New York Moten dismissed six men, brought in Walter Page and Jo Jones, and kept two pianos with Bus Moten.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

Like Booker?
Booker Washington, Woody Walder --
How about Mack Washington?
Mack Washington, the drummer and let me see -- I think they got rid of about six of them. Thamon Hayes.
Do you remember who replaced Mack Washington on the drums? Jones didn't join the band, did he, until Basie took over it?
Yes, he did.
Did he? Maybe he replaced Mack Washington.
He replaced Mack Washington.

With Walter Page.

No.
No relation at all. When did Freddie Green join the band?
He never was with Basie, not until Basie went to New York.

They continued to play around and play one nighters and --

Ed was with him?
Ed was with him; but he let Ed go. See now there there was Woody Walder, Ed Lewis --
Booker.

Vernon Page.
